SourceString: Carts are used to load and transport goods. They wear down with use and require {B_HP_C}repairs{##}.
You start with one cart, and you can buy new ones at the {B_PUB_MKT_C}Marketplace{##}, where you may find different models.

Did you know? You can select a cart in the city and hire thugs to {A_ATKCAR_C}attack{##} it. The profit can be tempting — but it works both ways, so {A_HIRESC_C}hiring an escort{##} for your cart is often wise.
How swiftly the cart rolls — depends on its build, condition, and the road's mood.
Need more {CAR_C}carts{##} — or fewer? Visit the {B_PUB_MKT_E}Marketplace{##} to buy or sell them.
Hire mercenaries to defend your cart against lurking robbers during its journey.
Currently hired escort will be dismissed.
You have no carts parked here.
All items inside will be permanently lost.
One goat. One slot. Endless opinions from the goat about the route. Light enough to trot at a decent {CAR_SPE_C}pace{##}, but skip {B_HP_C}maintenance{##} and you'll be pushing it back yourself.
Experienced merchants swear by the donkey cart. {B_HP_MAX_C}Tough{##} enough to outlast a few rough seasons. Two slots won't carry everything — but what it carries, it carries {CAR_SPE_C}fast{##}.
Why take two trips when one will do? The horse cart keeps up with the {CAR_SPE_C}nimble{##} donkey and carries twice the cargo. Built {B_HP_MAX_C}sturdier{##} than anything before it.
Six slots and the {B_HP_MAX_C}toughest{##} frame on any road. The ox doesn't {CAR_SPE_C}hurry{##} for anyone — but when you're carrying this much, you don't need to.
Wheels sink and axles strain, delaying the journey — usually thanks to {B_HP_C}neglected carts{##} or underdeveloped {C_QUA_C}quarters{##}.
Carts can suffer {A_ATKCAR_C}ambushes{##} from lurking robbers. Take care when passing through {ST_QTR_CRI_3_C}dangerous quarters{##}, or {A_HIRESC_C}hire escorts{##} to protect your goods.
To sell your wares at the marketplace, you should load your cart and dispatch it there.
An unguarded cart is easy prey for {A_ATKCAR_C}attackers{##}. Hire an {A_HIRESC_C}escort{##} to protect it.
Unprotected carts are more likely to be {A_ATKCAR_C}attacked{##}, especially when they are carrying valuable items. Hire an {A_HIRESC_C}escort{##} to guard them.
Controlled by the Master of its assigned building.
